capabilities.target: the explicitly selected publication root and its sibling transaction trees
capabilities.justification: Verifies existing and staged regular-file bytes, metadata, containment, and digests before reporting an unchanged tree or swapping a prepared tree.

capabilities.target: the explicitly selected publication root and its sibling transaction trees
capabilities.justification: Enumerates complete trees without following links so stale, linked, hard-linked, or unexpected entries cannot escape validation.

capabilities.target: exclusive staging, lock, backup, and rollback paths beside the explicitly selected publication root
capabilities.justification: Creates private same-filesystem transaction trees and exclusive files before the complete publication root is swapped.

capabilities.target: exclusive files beneath the private staging tree beside the explicitly selected publication root
capabilities.justification: Writes only core-verified byte snapshots into newly created staging files and fsyncs each file before commit.

capabilities.target: owned staging, lock, backup, and rollback paths beside the explicitly selected publication root
capabilities.justification: Cleans transaction-owned trees after finalize or rollback without deleting siblings outside the configured publication boundary.

justification: Stages and swaps a complete validated Forme output tree beneath one explicitly selected filesystem root. It performs no network, environment, shell, or subprocess access. External roots require the caller to obtain the separate filesystem:user grant described by FM08.
